account_sid.description: The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that created this Conference resource.

date_created.description: The date and time in UTC that this resource was created specified in [RFC 2822](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2822.txt) format.

date_updated.description: The date and time in UTC that this resource was last updated, specified in [RFC 2822](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2822.txt) format.

api_version.description: The API version used to create this conference.

friendly_name.description: A string that you assigned to describe this conference room. Maximum length is 128 characters.

region.description: A string that represents the Twilio Region where the conference audio was mixed. May be `us1`, `us2`, `ie1`,  `de1`, `sg1`, `br1`, `au1`, and `jp1`. Basic conference audio will always be mixed in `us1`. Global Conference audio will be mixed nearest to the majority of participants.

sid.description: The unique, Twilio-provided string used to identify this Conference resource.

uri.description: The URI of this resource, relative to `https://api.twilio.com`.

subresource_uris.description: A list of related resources identified by their URIs relative to `https://api.twilio.com`.

call_sid_ending_conference.description: The call SID that caused the conference to end.
